exclusions.title: NMOS current mirror
exclusions.detail: klt gen-compose cannot wire a diode-connected mirror from mos_array blocks (bare-poly gate pins need gate_contact and the shared-net backbone would cross a block's own pad), so the gen-only arm has no recipe. Excluded from all three arms. First failure: compose: gen-compose left nets unrouted: ['IREF', 'VSS']
